groups.name: Provenance
groups.description: Every row has an HTTPS source on the retailer's own domain, a retrieval date, and a usable evidence string.

groups.name: Price traceable to evidence
groups.description: The price digits must literally occur in the evidence text captured from the official source. A price that is not in its evidence is treated as hallucinated.

groups.name: Karat validity and traceability
groups.description: Karat must be a legal mark (10/14/18/22/24) and must also be stated in the row's own evidence text (including 750/1000 fineness for 18K).

groups.name: Internal arithmetic
groups.description: Price and weight ranges must be ordered and positive; a struck-through price cannot be below the price being charged.

groups.name: Solid-gold claim honesty
groups.description: A row may only claim "solid stated" when the captured seller text actually contains the word solid.

groups.name: Melt-value plausibility
groups.description: If a weight is published, the asking price cannot be below the gold content. A price under melt means the weight, karat or price is wrong.

groups.name: Plated-metal guard
groups.description: Plating, vermeil or gold-filled language must never pass silently. It either disqualifies the row or raises a flag.

groups.name: Date and price-feed sanity
groups.description: Retrieval dates must be real and not in the future; the stored gold price must be a positive number with an ISO publisher timestamp.

groups.name: Identity and schema
groups.description: IDs and source URLs must be unique, retailers and categories must exist, and every flag must carry a source and the "needs review" status.

groups.name: No silent blanks
groups.description: A blank value is allowed only when a flag explains it, and a price range must be disclosed as varying.

groups.name: Links and placeholders
groups.description: Every internal link and asset reference in every generated page must resolve to a real file, and no page may contain placeholder text.

groups.name: Row-to-page coverage
groups.description: Every row must have a detail page that shows its source link and, unless the value is unverified, its verified price.

groups.name: Source registry coverage
groups.description: Every retailer used for a value must appear in the source registry with a retrieval record.

groups.name: Weight traceability
groups.description: A weight in grams is only allowed when the grams appear in the evidence text captured from the seller, and the blank/known flags must agree with the stored value.

groups.name: Re-verification ledger
groups.description: Anything the site calls "re-verified" must have a matching ledger entry with the same URL, a date and a quoted line, so the re-read can be audited by a human.

groups.name: No invented dollar amounts
groups.description: Every dollar figure that appears on any generated page must trace to a value in the data files or to a formula computed from them. A price in the prose that exists nowhere in the data is treated as fabricated.

groups.name: Data age
groups.description: A published price snapshot older than 30 days fails the run, and the re-verification count on the rows must equal the ledger. Stale data must not be presented as current.

groups.name: Unverified values are published as unverified
groups.description: A value that could not be reproduced on the official page must be marked, explained, listed on the Flagged page, and never shown as a number.

groups.name: Unverified prices never render as numbers
groups.description: A row whose price could not be reproduced must print "— unverified" wherever a price would go.
